entities.summary: Stephen Alvin Resnick was an American Marxist economist. He was well known for his work on Marxian economics, economic methodology, and class analysis. His work, along with that of Wolff, is especially associated with a post-Althusserian perspective on political economy. Stephen Resnick was a performers & entertainers from United States (1938-10-24–2013-01-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
